title: Elbit Systems Files a Shelf Prospectus in Israel
body_markdown:
Elbit Systems Ltd. announced today that it has filed a shelf prospectus with the Israel Securities Authority and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (the “Shelf Prospectus”).
The Shelf Prospectus will be effective for a period of two years and will enable the Company to raise funds from time to time through offerings and sales of various securities, including debt and equity, in Israel, at the Company’s discretion. Any offering will be made pursuant to a supplemental shelf offering report describing the terms of the securities and the specific details of the offering.


The Company has not made any decision regarding the scope, terms, or timing of any offering pursuant to the Shelf Prospectus, and there is no certainty that any offering will be made.


Any securities offered pursuant to the Shelf Prospectus will not be registered under the U.S. Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "Securities Act"), and may not be offered or sold in the United States or to U.S. Persons (as defined in Regulation S under the Securities Act) absent registration or an applicable exemption. Any offering pursuant to the Shelf Prospectus will be made only in Israel unless otherwise provided in a supplemental shelf offering report, and will be subject to registration or exemption as required.


This press release does not constitute an offer to sell, or the solicitation of an offer to buy, any securities.
